create_DSDLDetDataset: create a DSDLDetDataset instance to load detection data from a DSDL YAML configuration file
load_data_list_DSDLDetDataset: load data info from a DSDL YAML file into a list of dictionaries with image and instance data
filter_data_DSDLDetDataset: filter dataset annotations by empty ground truth or minimum image size using filter_cfg settings
configure_DSDLDetDataset_with_bbox: configure DSDLDetDataset with bounding box, polygon, mask, and image level label loading options
load_DSDLDetDataset_with_hierarchy: load DSDLDetDataset with class hierarchy information to retrieve relation matrix and leaf node labels
